title: The Story of Roger Stone and WikiLeaks

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域的一些核心领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分访谈进行现场直播，任何人都可以于 11月18日

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 在 nytimes.com 上免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得一个月的全媒体内容访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbar.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The special counsel's indictment of Roger Stone contains details as over-the-top as Stone himself,
sentences.zh: 特别检察官对罗杰·斯通的起诉书包含了和斯通本人一样夸张的细节，

sentences.en: including encouraging an associate to use a tactic straight from the Godfather filMs.
sentences.zh: 包括鼓励同伙使用直接出自电影《教父》的战术。

sentences.en: But the indictment itself is quite serious in finally making a link between the Trump campaign and WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 但起诉书本身非常严肃，它最终将特朗普竞选团队与维基解密联系在了一起。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 1月28日，星期一。

sentences.en: Up at my home, pounded on the door.
sentences.zh: 来到我家，砰砰砸门。

sentences.en: We have some major breaking news in the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 关于穆勒调查，我们有一些重大突发新闻。

sentences.en: Roger Stone, you see him right there.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通，你们看就在那里。

sentences.en: President Trump's longtime political advisor, former campaign aide, has been arrested in Florida.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的长期政治顾问、前竞选助手在佛罗里达州被捕。

sentences.en: Charged with seven federal felonies, obstruction of an official proceeding, five counts of making false statements, and one count of witness tampering.
sentences.zh: 被控七项联邦重罪，包括妨碍官方程序、五项作虚假陈述罪以及一项篡改证人罪。

sentences.en: This has nothing to do with the president, has nothing to do with the White House.
sentences.zh: 这与总统无关，与白宫无关。

sentences.en: And beyond that, I'm not going to get into the back and forth.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我不想卷入这种来回的争论。

sentences.en: There is no circumstance whatsoever under which I will bear false witness against the president, nor will I make up lies to ease the pressure on myself.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，我都绝不会做伪证陷害总统，我也绝不会编造谎言来减轻我身上的压力。

sentences.en: I look forward to being fully and completely vindicated.
sentences.zh: 我期待着得到完全且彻底的平反。

sentences.en: So, Mark Mazzetti, what do we need to know about who Roger Stone is?
sentences.zh: 那么，马克·马佐蒂，关于罗杰·斯通究竟是谁，我们需要了解什么？

sentences.en: Roger Stone is a legendary Republican operative who, from the earliest days of his career,
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通是一位传奇的共和党操盘手，从他职业生涯的早期开始，

sentences.en: has plied the dark arts of scandal-mongering and dirty tricks in aid of political campaigns.
sentences.zh: 他就一直在政治竞选中大肆玩弄制造丑闻和恶意中伤的黑暗把戏。

sentences.en: Roger Stone is a trickster.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通是个骗子。

sentences.en: Roger Stone is a shady character, okay?
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通是个可疑的人物，好吗？

sentences.en: I know Roger Stone, and you know, he worked for Nixon.
sentences.zh: 我认识罗杰·斯通，你知道的，他曾为尼克松工作过。

sentences.en: He famously tattooed his hero on his back, and who among us can say that?
sentences.zh: 他因把自己的偶像纹在背上而闻名，我们当中有谁能做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: Yes, the questionable consultant's resume is filled with work for Republican stars.
sentences.zh: 是的，这位饱受质疑的顾问的履历上满是为共和党明星效力的经历。

sentences.en: Nixon, Reagan, Bush Sr.
sentences.zh: 尼克松、里根、老布什。

sentences.en: He is someone who very proudly talks about how he tries to plant stories with the press.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常自豪地谈论自己如何试图向媒体安插爆料的人。

sentences.en: Someone who tries to dig up any kind of personal dirt about a candidate in order to help the other side.
sentences.zh: 一个试图挖掘候选人任何个人黑料以帮助另一方的人。

sentences.en: I'm certainly guilty of bluffing and posturing and punking the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我当然承认自己有过虚张声势、摆出姿态以及捉弄民主党人的行为。

sentences.en: Unless they pass some law against bullsh** and I missed it, I'm engaging in tradecraft.
sentences.zh: 除非他们通过了什么法律禁止胡说八道而我漏掉了，否则我是在运用行话手腕。

sentences.en: It's politics.
sentences.zh: 这就是政治。

sentences.en: I'm sure it's driving the Democrats crazy, but there's nothing illegal about it.
sentences.zh: 我确信这快把民主党人逼疯了，但这是完全合法的。

sentences.en: So this is someone who, well, for many people who hate politics, they would hate someone like Roger Stone.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个这样的人，嗯，对于许多痛恨政治的人来说，他们会痛恨罗杰·斯通这样的人。

sentences.en: The truth is, Jimmy Carter's middle name was not Hussein.
sentences.zh: 事实是，吉米·卡特的中间名并不是侯赛因。

sentences.en: A very substantial number of people wonder, because of the policies of this administration, about whether the president is a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 相当数量的人因为本届政府的政策，对总统是否是穆斯林产生了疑问。

sentences.en: They may wonder, but should a presidential candidate like Trump be saying that, or at least condoning it with his silence?
sentences.zh: 他们可能会好奇，但像特朗普这样的总统候选人应该说这种话吗，或者至少用沉默来纵容它？

sentences.en: I don't think he commented either way.
sentences.zh: 我认为他没有对此发表任何评论。

sentences.en: He goes on television in strange outfits.
sentences.zh: 他穿着奇怪的衣服上电视。

sentences.en: He gives interviews from his pool.
sentences.zh: 他在游泳池边接受采访。

sentences.en: And clearly, in many cases, doesn't take himself too seriously.
sentences.zh: 而且显然在许多情况下，他并没有把自己看得太严肃。

sentences.en: So he's kind of a sideshow.
sentences.zh: 所以他算是一个边缘人物。

sentences.en: Except he's someone who Donald Trump has taken seriously for a long time.
sentences.zh: 除了唐纳德·特朗普长期以来一直很看重他这一点。

sentences.en: He's a regular guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个普通人。

sentences.en: You can talk to him like a regular person.
sentences.zh: 你可以像跟普通人一样跟他说话。

sentences.en: There's nothing formal or stilted about him.
sentences.zh: 他身上没有任何形式主义或矫揉造作。

sentences.en: And he's funny.
sentences.zh: 而且他很幽默。

sentences.en: He's got a great self-deprecating wit.
sentences.zh: 他有着极好的自嘲幽默感。

sentences.en: He's just fun to be with.
sentences.zh: 和他在一起就是很有趣。

sentences.en: If he's been this sort of informal advisor to Trump over decades and someone who, long,
sentences.zh: 如果几十年来他一直是特朗普这种非正式的顾问，并且在很久很久以前，

sentences.en: long before anyone took seriously the idea of Donald Trump being the president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 在任何人把唐纳德·特朗普当选美国总统的想法当回事之前很久，

sentences.en: Roger Stone was pushing this idea.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通就在极力推销这个想法。

sentences.en: It was not until 1987, really, late 87, that I began thinking about him as a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 直到1987年，也就是87年年末，我才真正开始把他当作总统候选人来考虑。

sentences.en: Although it has often been a contentious relationship.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们之间的关系常常充满争议。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think we have a complicated relationship.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为我们的关系很复杂。

sentences.en: But first of all, recognize I'm a Trump loyaliSt. Even when he's wrong, I'll be there.
sentences.zh: 但首先，要认识到我是特朗普的忠实拥趸。即使他错了，我也会支持他。

sentences.en: They've been at odds at times.
sentences.zh: 他们有时也曾产生过分歧。

sentences.en: He's someone who didn't last very long on the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 他是一个在特朗普竞选团队里没有呆多久的人。

sentences.en: He started out as an official campaign advisor, but was fired from the campaign pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 他一开始是官方的竞选顾问，但很快就被竞选团队解雇了。

sentences.en: And more turmoil for Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普迎来了更多的动荡。

sentences.en: A top longtime associate, both from his business world and in the political realm.
sentences.zh: 一个来自他商业世界和政治领域的长期高级核心密友。

sentences.en: Roger Stone is out tonight.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通今晚出局了。

sentences.en: Dispute about whether he resigned or was fired.
sentences.zh: 关于他是辞职还是被解雇存在争议。

sentences.en: Trump's campaign says Stone was fired because he was using the campaign to seek publicity for himself.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的竞选团队表示，斯通被解雇是因为他利用竞选活动为自己谋取名气。

sentences.en: I have no interest in going back.
sentences.zh: 我没有兴趣回去。

sentences.en: Although I strongly support Trump, we have managerial differences.
sentences.zh: 尽管我强烈支持特朗普，但我们在管理上有分歧。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, I'm just making the very best case for him in public that I can because I do think he has what it takes.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我只是在公开场合尽可能地为他进行最好的辩护，因为我确实认为他具备成功的素质。

sentences.en: And insofar as he was involved in the campaign, what exactly was his role as an informal advisor?
sentences.zh: 既然他参与了竞选，作为非正式顾问，他的确切角色是什么？

sentences.en: What did that amount to?
sentences.zh: 这究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: He was the classic late night phone call person to sort of listen to what Trump was thinking.
sentences.zh: 他扮演着那种经典的深夜电话热线人物角色，用来倾听特朗普的想法。

sentences.en: He was the confidant of then-candidate Trump, talking to him by phone, being a sort of back channel of advice outside official campaign communications.
sentences.zh: 他是时任候选人特朗普的知己，通过电话与他交谈，成为官方竞选沟通渠道之外的一种备用顾问渠道。

sentences.en: You didn't always know that Roger Stone was there because he did have this behind-the-scenes role.
sentences.zh: 你并不总是知道罗杰·斯通在那里，因为他确实有着这种幕后的角色。

sentences.en: But it was pretty apparent to people close to Trump that Roger Stone had this sort of outsized influence over Trump.
sentences.zh: 但对特朗普亲近的人来说，很明显罗杰·斯通对特朗普有着这种巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: It seems to me there's more than meets the eye here with Roger Stone parting company from the Trump campaign, coming on my program and others, and giving the big Trump pitch.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，罗杰·斯通与特朗普竞选团队分道扬镳，又来到我的节目和其他地方发表对特朗普的大力吹捧，这其中大有文章。

sentences.en: You media types are so conspiratorial.
sentences.zh: 你们这些媒体人真是太阴谋论了。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: The Stone-Trump types, I think, are the conspiratorial.
sentences.zh: 我认为斯通和特朗普这一类人才是阴谋论者。

sentences.en: So he was behind the scenes until he wasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以他一直隐居幕后，直到他不再隐居。

sentences.en: In August of 2016, a few months before the election, Roger Stone sent a very cryptic tweet about Podesta.
sentences.zh: 在2016年8月，也就是大选前几个月，罗杰·斯通发布了一条关于波德斯塔的充满神秘色彩的推文。

sentences.en: Roger Stone tweeted that it would soon be, quote, Podesta's time in the barrel.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通发推文称，用他的话说，波德斯塔很快就要倒霉了。

sentences.en: And he said it will soon be his time in the barrel.
sentences.zh: 他说他很快就要倒霉了。

sentences.en: Now, Podesta was John Podesta, the campaign chairman for Hillary Clinton, and no one really knew what that meant until a few months later in October,
sentences.zh: 当时，波德斯塔是希拉里·克林顿的竞选主席希拉里·波德斯塔，没有人真正明白这意味着什么，直到几个月后的10月，

sentences.en: a few weeks before the election, he sent out another tweet.
sentences.zh: 在大选前几周，他又发了一条推文。

sentences.en: I think he said, on Wednesday, Hillary Clinton is done, hashtag WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 我想他说的是，周三，希拉里·克林顿就完了，话题标签是维基解密。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Roger Stone writes, Thursday, October 6th, Julian Assange will deliver a devastating expose on Hillary at a time of his choosing.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通写道，10月6日，星期四，朱利安·阿桑奇将在他选择的时间发表一篇关于希拉里的毁灭性揭秘。

sentences.en: I stand by my prediction.
sentences.zh: 我坚持我的预测。

sentences.en: Hashtag handcuffs for Hillary.
sentences.zh: 话题标签：给希拉里戴上手铐。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: We need to talk about these hacked emails.
sentences.zh: 我们需要谈谈这些被黑客攻击的电子邮件。

sentences.en: The Podesta emails spill out a few days later.
sentences.zh: 几天后，波德斯塔的邮件泄露了出来。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks released more than 2,000 emails.
sentences.zh: 维基解密发布了2000多封电子邮件。

sentences.en: They claim they came from her campaign chairman, John Podesta, and other staffers.
sentences.zh: 他们声称这些邮件来自她的竞选主席约翰·波德斯塔和其他工作人员。

sentences.en: The leak revealed transcripts from some of Clinton's paid Wall Street speeches.
sentences.zh: 泄密事件披露了克林顿一些付费华尔街演讲的文字记录。

sentences.en: This is the first time that we're actually getting a look at these Wall Street speeches.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次真正看到这些华尔街演讲的内容。

sentences.en: What you see is that her own words really hit on her own perceived weaknesses, particularly around relatability and truSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，她自己的言论确实击中了她自己身上察觉到的弱点，特别是在亲和力和信任度方面。

sentences.en: You see why she really wasn't in a hurry to release these, as it really highlights a lot of concerns that voters have about her.
sentences.zh: 你明白为什么她真的不急于公布这些内容，因为这确实突显了选民对她的许多担忧。

sentences.en: And so this is, again, Roger Stone creating this image that he had a direct channel to WikiLeaks and knew what the information was going to be before it became public.
sentences.zh: 所以这再次体现了罗杰·斯通在塑造这样一种形象：他拥有直通维基解密的渠道，并且在信息公开之前就知道内容会是什么。

sentences.en: Right, and if I remember correctly, one of those WikiLeaks dumps of emails was right around the time of the Access Hollywood tape being published.
sentences.zh: 没错，如果我没记错的话，其中一次维基解密的邮件大泄露，正赶上《好莱坞记者》录音带被公开发布的时候。

sentences.en: October 7th, the Access Hollywood tape comes out.
sentences.zh: 10月7日，《好莱坞记者》录音带曝光。

sentences.en: One hour later, WikiLeaks starts dropping my emails into the public.
sentences.zh: 一个小时后，维基解密开始将我的邮件公之于众。

sentences.en: One could say that those things might not have been a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 人们可能会说，这些事情可能并非巧合。

sentences.en: Which was interesting timing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的时间点。

sentences.en: Within hours.
sentences.zh: 在几个小时内。

sentences.en: And, of course, that's very fortuitous timing if you're candidate Trump.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你是候选人特朗普，这个时间点真是太幸运了。

sentences.en: Very quickly, a lot of the media started focusing on the Podesta emails rather than this explosive story about the Access Hollywood tape.
sentences.zh: 很快，许多媒体开始关注波德斯塔的邮件，而不是关于《好莱坞记者》录音带的这则爆炸性新闻。

sentences.en: So at this point, justifiably, everyone is starting to wonder, does Roger Stone, this informal advisor to the president who is in touch with the campaign,
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，合情合理地，每个人都开始好奇，罗杰·斯通这个与竞选团队保持联系的总统非正式顾问，

sentences.en: does he have inside knowledge of what's going on at WikiLeaks?
sentences.zh: 他是否掌握了维基解密内部运作的内幕消息？

sentences.en: Is he coordinating with this organization?
sentences.zh: 他是否在与这个组织进行协调？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And remember, Roger Stone has built a career on creating an image that he does have great access.
sentences.zh: 请记住，罗杰·斯通的职业生涯正是建立在塑造自己拥有极佳渠道的形象之上。

sentences.en: I actually have communicated with Assange.
sentences.zh: 我实际上与阿桑奇进行过沟通。

sentences.en: I believe the next tranche of his documents pertain to the Clinton Foundation.
sentences.zh: 我相信他的下一批文件与克林顿基金会有滑。

sentences.en: He does have insight that others don't.
sentences.zh: 他确实拥有别人没有的见解。

sentences.en: I think that Assange is going to be very influential in this election because he's going to be educating the American people about the Clintons.
sentences.zh: 我认为阿桑奇在这场选举中将极具影响力，因为他将向美国人民普及关于克林顿一家的信息。

sentences.en: Once the Russia investigation heats up, though, he has to reverse course.
sentences.zh: 不过，一旦俄罗斯调查白热化，他就不得不改变口径。

sentences.en: I had no advance notice of the content source or the exact disclosure time of the WikiLeaks disclosures.
sentences.zh: 我事先不知道维基解密披露的内容来源或准确的披露时间。

sentences.en: Assange himself has said so.
sentences.zh: 阿桑奇本人也这么说过。

sentences.en: In fact, Assange has said in his own tweets and in interviews that Roger Stone never predicted anything that I hadn't already said in public.
sentences.zh: 事实上，阿桑奇在自己的推文和采访中都说过，罗杰·斯通从未预测过任何他尚未在公开场合说过的话。

sentences.en: He has to sort of paint himself as someone who didn't have that knowledge, who didn't have any insight,
sentences.zh: 他不得不把自己粉饰成一个没有那种内幕知识、没有任何见解的人，

sentences.en: because that was something that could potentially put him in real legal jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 因为这可能会让他陷入真正的法律危机之中。

sentences.en: So what did we learn from this indictment last week about what was really going on here?
sentences.zh: 那么我们从上周的这份起诉书中了解到了这里面到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what we learned on Friday is that Roger Stone, in fact, did have insights into what WikiLeaks was doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在周五了解到的是，罗杰·斯通事实上确实对维基解密的行动有所了解。

sentences.en: He made extensive efforts to find out what Julian Assange was planning.
sentences.zh: 他付出了巨大努力去查明朱利安·阿桑奇的计划。

sentences.en: And we find out that he was directed by people inside the campaign to go find out what WikiLeaks was doing.
sentences.zh: 我们发现他是受竞选团队内部人员的指示去打听维基解密在做什么。

sentences.en: So we really, for the first time, have a sense that there was a link between WikiLeaks's efforts to damage Hillary Clinton
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的是第一次感觉到，维基解密旨在损害希拉里·克林顿的努力，

sentences.en: and the Trump campaign's efforts to damage Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 与特朗普竞选团队旨在损害希拉里·克林顿的努力之间存在着一种联系。

sentences.en: And that link was Roger Stone.
sentences.zh: 而那个联系人就是罗杰·斯通。

sentences.en: And something else that should not be lost in all this is that all of this was happening months after it was first revealed that the Russian government was behind this operation
sentences.zh: 还有一点不应在所有这些中被忽视，那就是这一切发生时，距离首次披露俄罗斯政府是这起行动的幕后黑手已经过去了几个月，

sentences.en: to hack the Democratic servers and put the information out through WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 该行动旨在入侵民主党服务器并通过维基解密发布信息。

sentences.en: And that's significant because it's one thing to be coordinating with WikiLeaks when no one quite knows how it got those internal Clinton emails.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为在一个无人知晓克林顿内部邮件是如何获取的时候与维基解密进行协调是一回事，

sentences.en: It's another to be coordinating with WikiLeaks once it's understood that the emails it's disseminating were stolen by Russia.
sentences.zh: 而一旦人们明白其正在散布的邮件是被俄罗斯盗取的，再去与维基解密协调则是另一回事。

sentences.en: It seems to elevate this above wanting negative information about your opponent out in the world.
sentences.zh: 这似乎把这件事提升到了不仅仅是希望关于对手的负面信息公之于众的高度。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All of this was done while it was well known that the Russians were behind this operation.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切发生时，俄罗斯人是这次行动的幕后黑手已经是众所周知的事实。

sentences.en: So do we know who on the campaign was talking to Roger Stone and encouraging him to keep communicating with WikiLeaks and find out when their leaks would occur?
sentences.zh: 那么我们知道竞选团队里是谁在与罗杰·斯通交谈，并鼓励他继续与维基解密保持沟通以查明他们的泄密何时会发生吗？

sentences.en: That's where it becomes really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这就是事情变得真正有趣的地方。

sentences.en: The Times reported a few months ago that Steve Bannon, who was the campaign chairman at the end, was in contact with Roger Stone about this.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》几个月前报道称，曾在最后担任竞选主席的史蒂夫·班农曾就此事与罗杰·斯通保持联系。

sentences.en: In early October, Stone writes Steve Bannon that WikiLeaks would release, quote, a load every week going forward.
sentences.zh: 在10月初，斯通写信给史蒂夫·班农，称维基解密此后将每周发布“猛料”。

sentences.en: He separately writes to a supporter involved in the Trump campaign, quote, spoke to my friend in London last night.
sentences.zh: 他另外写信给一名参与特朗普竞选的支持者，称“昨晚与我在伦敦的朋友通了话”。

sentences.en: The payload is still coming.
sentences.zh: 内幕消息还在不断浮出水面。

sentences.en: Friend in London, presumably meaning Julian Assange.
sentences.zh: 伦敦的朋友，大概是指朱利安·阿桑奇。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the Mueller indictment has a very tantalizing detail.
sentences.zh: 但穆勒的起诉书中有一个非常抓人眼球的细节。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 什么细节？

sentences.en: The indictment said that a senior campaign official, quote, was directed by someone to contact Stone about additional WikiLeaks releases.
sentences.zh: 起诉书称，一名竞选高级官员，“引用”奉某人之命就维基解密的新爆料与斯通联系。

sentences.en: There's a very odd use of the passive voice that you would not expect in an indictment written by lawyers with Ivy League educations.
sentences.zh: 这里非常奇怪地使用了被动语态，你在由受过常春藤盟校教育的律师撰写的起诉书中是不会预料到这一点的。

sentences.en: The indictment does not say who it was that directed the senior campaign official.
sentences.zh: 起诉书并未说明究竟是谁下令让这位竞选高级官员这么做的。

sentences.en: Of course, it's led to speculation that that person could only be Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 当然，这引发了一种猜测，即此人非唐纳德·特朗普莫属。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知。

sentences.en: Everything you're describing here about Roger Stone's communications with the campaign and Roger Stone's communications with WikiLeaks, it sounds quite nefarious.
sentences.zh: 你刚才描述的关于罗杰·斯通与竞选团队的沟通，以及罗杰·斯通与维基解密的沟通，听起来都挺邪乎的。

sentences.en: But I wonder if it is illegal.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇这是否违法。

sentences.en: Is his communication with WikiLeaks what Roger Stone was indicted for?
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通被起诉是因为他与维基解密的沟通吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: The charge is Stone lying to Congress about his interactions with WikiLeaks, trying to tamper with witness testimony, and an overall charge of obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 指控是斯通就其与维基解密的互动对国会撒谎、试图干预证人证词，以及一项总体的妨碍司法公正罪。

sentences.en: As for the witness tampering charge, that centers around Stone's interactions with someone named Randy Credico,
sentences.zh: 至于干预证人的指控，核心是斯通与一个叫兰迪·克雷迪科的人的互动，

sentences.en: who is a longtime New York radio personality, on-again, off-again friend of Stone, and someone who did, in fact, seem to have direct connections to Julian Assange and WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 他长期在纽约担任电台名人，是斯通时断时续的朋友，而且他确实似乎与朱利安·阿桑奇和维基解密有直接联系。

sentences.en: And what the indictment details is that Roger Stone had several communications with Credico trying to make sure that Credico told the same story to the House that Roger Stone had told,
sentences.zh: 起诉书详细说明的是，罗杰·斯通与克雷迪科有过多次沟通，试图确保克雷迪科在众议院说出与罗杰·斯通相同的说辞，

sentences.en: and even suggesting that he should pull a, quote, Frank Pentangeli before the committee.
sentences.zh: 甚至暗示他在委员会面前应该“引用”扮演弗兰克·彭坦杰利。

sentences.en: Did you serve under Capo regime, Peter Clemenza, under Vito Corleone, also known as the Godfather?
sentences.zh: 你曾在教父维托·科里昂麾下的基干头目彼得·克莱门扎手下效力吗，也就是人称的教父？

sentences.en: And that is a reference to a character in The Godfather 2 who is called before Congress to testify about the mob and all of a sudden gets amnesia.
sentences.zh: 这是在致敬《教父2》里的一个角色，他被传唤到国会作证指证黑手党，结果突然失忆了。

sentences.en: I ask you again, sir, here and now, under Oro, were you at any time a member of a crime organization headed by Michael Corleone?
sentences.zh: 我再次问你，先生，就在此时此地，在奥罗手下，你曾一度加入过以迈克尔·科里昂为首的犯罪组织吗？

sentences.en: I don't know nothing about that.
sentences.zh: 我对此一无所知。

sentences.en: Oh, I was in the olive oil business with his father, but that was a long time ago, that's all.
sentences.zh: 哦，我曾与他父亲做过橄榄油生意，但那是很久以前的事了，仅此而已。

sentences.en: And why isn't Mueller going after Stone for anything other than the lying, for the actions he lied about?
sentences.zh: 为什么穆勒起诉斯通只是因为说谎，而不是因为他撒谎所掩盖的那些行为？

sentences.en: It's hard to make a conspiracy case.
sentences.zh: 要坐实阴谋罪很难。

sentences.en: The fact is that the emails appear to have been stolen before Roger Stone knew about them, so he didn't seem to have participated in the theft.
sentences.zh: 事实是，这些电子邮件似乎在罗杰·斯通得知之前就已经被盗了，所以他似乎并没有参与盗窃。

sentences.en: And he seemed to maybe be trafficking in information that was becoming public or was about to be public.
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎只是在倒卖那些正要公开或即将公开的信息。

sentences.en: And this is what his defenders and the president's defenders have pointed out, that these are all crimes that happened after the fact.
sentences.zh: 这也是他的辩护者和总统的辩护者所指出的，这些都是事后才发生的罪行。

sentences.en: He is not being charged with something that's at the bottom of this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 他被指控的并不是整件事的根源所在。

sentences.en: Collusion, conspiracy, etc.
sentences.zh: 勾结、阴谋等等。

sentences.en: And this is what, of course, President Trump has fallen back on for some time.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是特朗普总统一段时间以来一直老调重弹的。

sentences.en: This is why this thing is so weird, strange.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这件事如此诡异、奇怪。

sentences.en: The crime is conspiracy to hack.
sentences.zh: 罪名是阴谋黑客攻击。

sentences.en: Collusion is not a crime.
sentences.zh: 勾结不是犯罪。

sentences.en: It doesn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 它根本不存在。

sentences.en: No, conspiracy to defraud the government, you're right.
sentences.zh: 不对，是阴谋诈骗政府，你说得对。

sentences.en: Conspiracy to hack, that is the crime.
sentences.zh: 阴谋黑客攻击，这才是罪行。

sentences.en: We don't know whether—
sentences.zh: 我们不知道——

sentences.en: Now, did Donald Trump engage in a conspiracy to hack with the Russians?
sentences.zh: 那么，唐纳德·特朗普是否参与了与俄罗斯人合谋黑客攻击？

sentences.en: They've been going at it.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在彻查此事。

sentences.en: The counterintelligence investigation came to the conclusion, no evidence.
sentences.zh: 反情报调查得出的结论是，没有证据。

sentences.en: Mark, it feels like time and time again when it comes to the Mueller investigation,
sentences.zh: 马克，感觉一次又一次地，每当谈到穆勒调查时，

sentences.en: he and his prosecutors are charging people around the president with lying or tampering with a witness or doing something deceptive around their interactions with his own investigation.
sentences.zh: 他和他的检察官都在指控总统身边的人撒谎、干预证人，或者在与他自己调查的互动中做出欺骗行为。

sentences.en: But not with actually colluding with Russia or coordinating with Russia or being involved in a conspiracy that involves Russia, which, of course,
sentences.zh: 但并没有指控他们真正与俄罗斯勾结、与俄罗斯协调，或者卷入涉及俄罗斯的阴谋中，而这当然，

sentences.en: is what this investigation is really about.
sentences.zh: 才是这项调查的真正意义所在。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: If you want to look at it as a best-case scenario for President Trump, it's that there's no original crime here.
sentences.zh: 如果你想用对特朗普总统最有利的视角来看待它，那就是这里根本没有最初的犯罪。

sentences.en: There's no collusion.
sentences.zh: 根本没有勾结。

sentences.en: There's no conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 根本没有阴谋。

sentences.en: They were charged because they were just lying to Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们被起诉只是因为他们对国会撒谎了。

sentences.en: Today's surprise guilty plea by Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩今天突然认罪。

sentences.en: Cohen said in federal court that he lied to Congress, he says, to support Mr. Trump's timeline of a Moscow real estate deal.
sentences.zh: 科恩在联邦法院表示，他向国会撒谎，他说，是为了配合特朗普先生关于莫斯科房地产交易的时间线。

sentences.en: Lying to the FBI, withholding evidence.
sentences.zh: 向联邦调查局撒谎，隐瞒证据。

sentences.en: Tonight,
sentences.zh: 今晚，

sentences.en: former Trump campaign aide George Papadopoulos admitting he lied to the FBI about his contacts with someone the FBI suspected of being a Russian operative to cover for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 前特朗普竞选顾问乔治·帕帕多普洛斯承认，他曾就自己与联邦调查局怀疑是俄罗斯特工的人的接触情况向联邦调查局撒谎，以掩护特朗普总统。

sentences.en: But the worst-case scenario is that they are lying to protect something big.
sentences.zh: 但最坏的情况是，他们撒谎是为了掩盖什么大事。

sentences.en: They were so concerned about what's at the bottom of this story that they had to lie to keep investigators from getting there.
sentences.zh: 他们如此关心这个故事底部的黑幕，以至于不得不撒谎来阻止调查人员触及真相。

sentences.en: That's been one of the enduring mysteries of this entire story.
sentences.zh: 这一直是整个故事中挥之不去的谜团之一。

sentences.en: Was there a grand conspiracy?
sentences.zh: 是否存在一个宏大的阴谋？

sentences.en: Or does this all add up to small individual acts, individual contacts with Russians, individual business deals gone bad,
sentences.zh: 还是这一切只是由许多微小的个人行为、与俄罗斯人的个人接触、破裂的个人商业交易拼凑而成的，

sentences.en: that individual people were trying to lie to cover up their own role?
sentences.zh: 而个人只是在试图撒谎来掩盖他们自己的角色？

sentences.en: The fact that we don't know where Mueller is going and Mueller only reveals his strategy in individual indictments means that we're still left with these kinds of questions.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道穆勒的下一步走向，而穆勒只在各自的起诉书中透露他的策略，这意味着我们仍然留有这些疑问。

sentences.en: And in this latest indictment, we've learned that Roger Stone, who has not been taken very seriously all this time, now seems to represent something quite important in all of this.
sentences.zh: 而在这份最新的起诉书中，我们了解到，一直以来没有被太当回事的罗杰·斯通，现在似乎在这场风波中扮演了相当重要的角色。

sentences.en: Yes, in many ways, Roger Stone was this kind of cartoonish figure.
sentences.zh: 是的，在很多方面，罗杰·斯通都是这种滑稽卡通式的人物。

sentences.en: If this were a whodunit, he'd be the obvious suspect that a reader would have long ago dismissed because he's too obvious.
sentences.zh: 如果这是一个悬疑故事，他会是那个读者早就排除的明显嫌疑人，因为他太显眼了。

sentences.en: And yet, here's Roger Stone being charged with very serious crimes.
sentences.zh: 然而，罗杰·斯通却在这里被指控犯有非常严重的罪行。

sentences.en: And for the first time, we see Mueller show his hand that there really was this direct link between the Trump campaign and WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次看到穆勒亮出底牌，表明特朗普竞选团队与维基解密之间确实存在这种直接联系。

sentences.en: But I think the bigger point is the question of how directly the Trump campaign officials were working with the original source of the information,
sentences.zh: 但我认为更重要的一点是，特朗普竞选官员与信息的最初来源合作得有多直接的问题，

sentences.en: and that is the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 也就是俄罗斯政府。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks was a pass-through here.
sentences.zh: 维基解密在这里只是一个中转站。

sentences.en: The Russian government, Russian hackers gave it to WikiLeaks to distribute.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府、俄罗斯黑客将其交给维基解密进行分发。

sentences.en: The real question at the end of the day is not the communications necessarily with WikiLeaks,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，真正的问题不一定是与维基解密的沟通，

sentences.en: but whether there was foreknowledge about what Russia was doing and any direct communication with the Russians about their campaign to sabotage Hillary Clinton's political future.
sentences.zh: 而是是否存在对俄罗斯行动的预知，以及是否就他们破坏希拉里·克林顿政治前途的运动与俄罗斯人进行过直接沟通。

sentences.en: Mark, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡，又会怎样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你的第一个月应用体验是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, my fellow Americans.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，我的美国同胞们。

sentences.en: I am very proud to announce today that we have reached a deal to end the shutdown and reopen the federal government.
sentences.zh: 我非常荣幸地在此宣布，我们已经达成协议，结束政府关门并重新开放联邦政府。

sentences.en: On Friday afternoon, just hours after the FBI raid of Roger Stone's home,
sentences.zh: 周五下午，就在联邦调查局突击搜查罗杰·斯通住所几小时后，

sentences.en: President Trump walked into the Rose Garden of the White House and announced victoriously that he was temporarily ending the shutdown with no agreement from the Democrats to fund his border wall.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统走进白宫玫瑰园，胜利地宣布他将暂时结束政府关门，而民主党并未就资助其边境墙达成任何协议。

sentences.en: I want to thank all of the incredible federal workers and their amazing families.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢所有不可思议的联邦工人和他们伟大的家属。

sentences.en: The announcement came a day after two bills to reopen the government, one sponsored by Republicans, the other by Democrats, failed to pass in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 此前一天，两项旨在重新开放政府的法案在参议院未能获得通过，一项由共和党人提出，另一项由民主党人提出。

sentences.en: And as frustration over the shutdown began to boil over in highly public and disruptive ways.
sentences.zh: 随着对政府关门的不满情绪开始以高度公开和破坏性的方式沸腾宣泄。

sentences.en: Both clowns, both sides should sit down and make it happen, including our president, including Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 两个都是小丑，双方都应该坐下来把事情办成，包括我们的总统，包括佩洛西。

sentences.en: It's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Not fair.
sentences.zh: 很不公平。

sentences.en: Not TSA's, you know, fault that they're not getting paid and stuff.
sentences.zh: 拿不到工资又不是美国运输安全管理局的错，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's the government's fault.
sentences.zh: 这是政府的错。

sentences.en: So the government should get it together.
sentences.zh: 所以政府应该振作起来。

sentences.en: By Friday, so many air traffic controllers had called in sick that the Federal Aviation Administration grounded flights across the NortheaSt.
sentences.zh: 到周五，已有如此多的空中交通管制员请病假，以至于联邦航空管理局下令美国东北部全境停飞。

sentences.en: Hundreds of workers at the IRS refused to show up for work.
sentences.zh: 国税局的数百名员工拒绝上班。

sentences.en: And the director of the FBI, Christopher Wray, had released a public message to his employees.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局局长克里斯托弗·雷向他的员工发布了一条公开信息。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: We're now five weeks and two missed paychecks into this mess.
sentences.zh: 这场混乱已经持续了五周，错过了两次发薪日。

sentences.en: And I wanted to touch base with all of you again.
sentences.zh: 我想再次和大家联络一下。

sentences.en: Making some people stay home when they don't want to and making others show up without pay, it's mind boggling.
sentences.zh: 强迫一些人留在家中而他们并不愿意，又强迫另一些人无薪上班，这简直令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: It's short sighted and it's unfair.
sentences.zh: 这是目光短浅的，也是不公平的。

sentences.en: It takes a lot to get me angry, but I'm about as angry as I've been in a long, long time.
sentences.zh: 要惹怒我可不容易，但我现在的愤怒程度可以说是久违了。

sentences.en: Unity among congressional Republicans, which had held for a month, began to collapse, with Republican senators, including Majority Leader Mitch McConnell,
sentences.zh: 维持了一个月的国会共和党人内部的团结开始瓦解，包括多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔在内的共和党参议员，

sentences.en: telling Vice President Mike Pence that the president's shutdown strategy was not working and needed to end immediately.
sentences.zh: 告诉副总统迈克·彭斯，总统的关门战略行不通，必须立即结束。

sentences.en: In his speech, the president, who has made the $5.7 billion in funding for his wall, a non-negotiable condition for ending the shutdown,
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，总统此前将57亿美元的建墙资金作为结束政府关门的不可谈判条件，

sentences.en: and who repeatedly rejected Democratic proposals to reopen the government while negotiations continue, ultimately did just that,
sentences.zh: 并且一再拒绝民主党人在谈判继续的同时重新开放政府的提议，最终还是这么做了，

sentences.en: restoring government to normal function for the next three weeks and promising to quickly pay back federal workers who have missed paychecks since the shutdown began.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的三周内恢复了政府的正常职能，并承诺迅速补发自政府关门以来未能领到薪水的联邦工人的工资。

sentences.en: But if we don't get a fair deal from Congress, the government will either shut down on February 15th again,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们无法从国会获得公平的协议，政府要么在2月15日再次关门，

sentences.en: or I will use the powers afforded to me under the laws and the Constitution of the United States to address this emergency.
sentences.zh: 要么我将动用美国法律和宪法赋予我的权力来应对这场紧急状态。

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans will enter formal negotiations this week to see if they can find a compromise on border security funding and on what constitutes a wall,
sentences.zh: 民主党和共和党本周将开始正式谈判，看他们能否就边境安全资金以及什么是墙达成妥协，

sentences.en: a definition that is evolving for the president himself.
sentences.zh: 这个定义对总统本人来说也在不断演变。

sentences.en: We do not need 2,000 miles of concrete wall from sea to shiny sea.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要从波光粼粼的海岸到海岸的2000英里长的混凝土墙。

sentences.en: We never did.
sentences.zh: 我们从来不需要。

sentences.en: We never proposed that.
sentences.zh: 我们从未提出过那种构想。

sentences.en: We never wanted that because we have barriers at the border where natural structures are as good as anything that we can build.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有想要过，因为我们在自然结构和我们能建造的任何东西一样好的边境上拥有天然屏障。

sentences.en: They're already there.
sentences.zh: 它们本来就在那里。

sentences.en: They've been there for millions of years.
sentences.zh: 它们已经在那里存在了数百万年。

sentences.en: That change in language and the decision to reopen the government with no funding for the wall drew condemnation from conservatives like Ann Coulter, who, many believe,
sentences.zh: 措辞的改变以及在没有建墙资金的情况下重新开放政府的决定，引发了安·库尔特等保守派的谴责，许多人认为，

sentences.en: helped push the president into a shutdown in the first place.
sentences.zh: 正是她当初把总统推向了政府关门。

sentences.en: Good news for George Herbert Walker Bush, Coulter wrote on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 对于乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什来说是个好消息，库尔特在推特上写道。

sentences.en: As of today, he is no longer the biggest wimp to ever serve as president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 从今天起，他不再是美国历史上当过总统的最大的懦夫了。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
